caption:
Stand up after a long meeting and your hips just won't straighten? Momo knows the feeling.

Sitting parks your hips in one position for hours, and that tight feeling is often your body asking for more movement. Pilates works the hips through bending, rotating and opening out under control, and builds strength so they feel confident to let go.

Hybi's 5-minute lunch routine: 10 leg swings each side, 5 slow half-kneeling stretches with a glute squeeze, 10 bridges. Then stand up every 30–45 minutes.

Sharp groin pain or tingling down the leg is worth an assessment. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can build a program around your week. Book online via the link in bio 🐱

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
